title: copilot publish --json
description: Author-side push of a writable org/department tier. The CLI computes the rebase/merge; Control Tower only renders the plain-language chooser and passes the pick back via --resolve. Exit 0 = published or a cleanly-reported conflict; 1 = refused; 2 = env/credential error.

tier.description: The writable org/dept tier being published. Security-relevant: a missing/empty tier => refuse to publish (fail-closed).

result.description: Publish/conflict outcome. A surfaced conflict is a normal outcome, not an error.

leak_scan.description: Tier-scoped fail-closed leak-scan result. Security-relevant: a missing or malformed leak_scan => refuse to publish (SOUL 'The Leak').
leak_scan.$comment: cli-contract.md/inheritance-and-publish.md require leak_scan and make it fail-closed, but do not enumerate its internal shape. Presence + object-ness is enforced here (absence is a hard schema failure); internal fields left open until the CLI freezes them.

conflict.description: Present only for needs-choice: content-level (never Git-marker) description of a true overlap.

state.$comment: cli-contract.md line 26 says conflict.state exists 'when conflict is present', but the needs-choice example payload omits it. Encoded as an optional mirror of `result`; owner to confirm whether it is actually emitted.

resolutions.description: Non-destructive options offered for needs-choice. keep-both is the always-available lossless floor; escalate is the always-available exit.

parked_ref.description: Durable held ref where a parked change is preserved (never lost). Present for parked-escalated.

escalated_to.description: Competent author / tier lead the parked change was escalated to (plain language, via §9 Bob-agency routing).

reason.description: Why the change was parked/escalated (sensitive path/class, or author declined).

allOf.$comment: auto-merged: rebased + non-overlapping hunks merged; push completed. Requires pushed_sha; no conflict/resolutions/park fields.
needs-choice: true overlap. Requires the rendered conflict and the non-destructive resolutions list.
parked-escalated: change parked on a durable ref and escalated. Requires parked_ref, escalated_to, reason.
